models.model_label: Monthly next-year forecast errors on working-capital-accrual portfolio rank
models.sample_description: Analyst forecast subsample: firm-years in the initial 21,482-observation sample with month-1 IBES forecast data. The regression is repeated for months s=1–12 after the prior year’s earnings announcement; N by month is 21,482, 21,360, 21,208, 21,030, 20,878, 20,700, 20,507, 20,269, 20,024, 19,685, 19,199, and 16,678.
models.method_details: Table 5 is explicitly titled Ordinary Least Squares Regressions of Forecast Errors on Accrual Portfolios.

dependent_variable.name: FError_{s,t+1}
dependent_variable.definition: Monthly analyst forecast error for year t+1 earnings: realized earnings for year t+1 minus the forecast in month s, divided by the stock price at the end of month 1. Month s=1 is the first month after announcement of year-t earnings, and the sequence runs through month 12 or the current-year earnings announcement. Analyst forecasts are the IBES annual earnings forecasts.
dependent_variable.formula: FError_{s,t+1} = (realized EPS_{t+1} - forecast EPS_{t+1,s}) / stock price_{month 1}.

evidence.quote: FError_(s,t+1) = beta_0 + beta_1*PortWCAcc_t + nu_(t+1).
Month s=1,...,12 is relative to the announcement of year-t earnings; forecast error for year-t+1 earnings is realized earnings minus forecast in month s, divided by stock price in month1 for every s.
PortWCAcc ranks annual working-capital-accrual portfolios, converted to[0,1].
WCAcc uses cash-flow-statement working-capital changes items302,303,304,305,307.
Our analyst forecast tests are conducted across fiscal months using the median IBES forecast of the current year annual earnings.

statistics.units: Forecast error for year t+1 earnings, scaled by stock price at month 1.

evidence.quote: FIG. 2.-Analyst forecast erors for deciles of acruals portfolios

review_notes: The figure communicates directional trajectories visually but supplies no exact numeric point values.

independent_variables.name: PortWCAcc_t
independent_variables.definition: Annual equal-number decile-portfolio rank of working-capital accruals WCAcc, converted to a [0,1] scale. WCAcc is the specified statement-of-cash-flows working-capital change aggregate, deflated by average total assets before annual ranking.
independent_variables.formula: PortWCAcc_t = annual decile rank of WCAcc_t, converted to [0,1].

evidence.quote: PortWCAcc is the portfolio ranking of the firm-year based on WCAcc in year t, scaled to a [0,1 ] range.
Firm-year observations are ranked annually and assigned in equal numbers to decile portfolios based on WCAcc.

WCAcc = Increase in Accounts Receivable (COMPUSTAT item #302) + Increase in Inventory (#303) + Decrease in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities (#304) + Decrease in Accrued Income Taxes (#305) + Increase (Decrease) in Assets (Liabilities)-Other (#307)
In our empirical tests, we deflate all variables by average total assets.

research_interest_evidence.quote: H1: Analysts' forecast errors with respect to future earnings are negatively associated with the level of accruals.

independent_variables.research_interest_reason: The portfolio rank is the focal accrual measure in H1, which predicts a negative association with future analyst forecast errors.

evidence.quote: Month s = 1 is the first month following the prior year's earnings announcement, month s = 2 is the second month following the prior year's earnings announcement, and so on.

scope.quote: First, we examine the earnings forecasts of sell-side analysts.

sample.quote: The sample constitutes observations in the initial sample of 21,482 firm-years for which analyst forecasts are available in month 1 on the IBES summary statistics file.

results_review_notes: The 12 month rows are 12 separate OLS fits. Individual coefficient t-statistics are reported; underlying standard errors are not printed.

models.model_label: Audit-opinion logit on year-0 accrual portfolio and contemporaneous controls; repeated over t=0 through t+3
models.sample_description: Compustat firm-year observations from the initial 66,762-observation sample (fiscal 1988–1998) with all required audit-opinion controls available. Table 7 fits t=0 and years t+1, t+2, and t+3 relative to year-0 accrual-portfolio formation; exact per-fit N is 19,852, 17,190, 14,713, and 12,499, respectively.
models.method_details: The paper says the regression is estimated using a logit model because the dependent variable is dichotomous.

dependent_variable.name: Unclean_t
dependent_variable.definition: Indicator equal to 0 for an unqualified clean audit opinion and 1 for any other modified opinion, including qualified, adverse, or unqualified with explanatory language. The opinion outcome is measured contemporaneously in year t relative to year-0 portfolio formation.

evidence.quote: Unclean=0 for unqualified opinion,1 for other opinion including qualified/adverse or unqualified with explanatory language.

The audit opinion variable (Unclean) is assigned the value of 0 for a standard unqualified opinion and the value of 1 for any other modified opinion, including qualified, adverse or unqualified with explanatory language

statistics.units: Number of audit-opinion firm-years in the clean (Unclean=0) and modified (Unclean=1) categories.

independent_variables.name: TA_t
independent_variables.definition: Log of total assets (Compustat item #6); the source does not specify the logarithm base.

review_notes: Selected the principal intermediary-information question with its two explicitly central outcome families: analyst forecast errors (Table 5) and audit opinions (Table 7). For Table 7, the paper presents the contemporaneous and three subsequent opinion fits as one repeated-horizon specification; each horizon is retained with its year-0 accrual rank and contemporaneous controls. Excluded the initial Sloan replication/market-efficiency analyses (Tables 2–4), the SEC enforcement-action premise check (Table 6), and auditor changes (Table 8), which the authors explicitly describe as supplementary to the audit-opinion tests.

The Table 5 OLS equation and horizon scaling and the Table 7 logit equation/control formulas were checked against the independently verified appended transcriptions in the supplied reading and visually inspected on physical PDF pages 22 and 26.

The log base used for TA=log(Assets) is not specified in the source. Standard-error corrections/clustering are not reported for the selected models; these absent reporting details are distinguished from the stated OLS/logit estimators.
results_review_notes: The retained baseline family is Table 5 monthly OLS forecast-error fits for months 1–12 and Table 7 audit-opinion logit fits for t=0 through t+3. Other model tables, robustness tests, and later additional tests are excluded.

All six frozen RHS terms are mapped and have role evidence. Table 5 reports coefficient estimates and signed t-statistics; Table 7 reports estimates and p-values in parentheses. Coefficient-level standard errors are not directly printed.
Table 1 and Table 6 WCAcc summaries are included only for the continuous raw version of the retained PortWCAcc rank. Table 7 opinion category counts summarize the retained Unclean outcome.

No separate descriptive statistics are reported for the transformed PortWCAcc rank or the Table 7 control variables TA, CFO, LEV, and TIE. Figure 2 shows FError mean trajectories but prints no numeric point values; no values were digitized from it.
Table 5 exact degrees of freedom are unreported. Table 7 does not identify the coefficient-level test type, reference distribution, degrees of freedom, or sidedness; those are left unknown.

calculation_provenance.policy: strict; no guessed degrees of freedom or normal approximations
